observations: QMP accepted balloon request, but reported actual memory initially remained about 6 GiB.
QEMU working set decreased from about 6.5 GB to about 3.7 GB.
ADB and SSH became unresponsive; restoring target to 6144 MiB did not restore responsiveness.
QEMU emitted MADVISE not available while inflating and Couldn't MADV_WILLNEED on balloon deflate: Invalid argument.
The later normal Stop operation succeeded cleanly, followed by a successful boot without a balloon device. Emergency termination was not needed.
cause: Host memory discard is unsupported in this build's Win32 path. The precise cause of the observed guest liveness failure remains unestablished; the paging-hint warning alone is not causal proof.
resolution: Remove virtio-balloon from the supported VM configuration, reject ReclaimMemory, use fixed startup profiles and recover the test guest explicitly.
